title: NASA asteroid fact sheet: most masses, and many diameters, are rough estimates
summary: The sheet says most mass values and many diameter values are only rough estimates, and gives orbit values for epoch JD 2457400.5.
body: NASA's Asteroid Fact Sheet says: "Most of the values for mass and many of the diameter values are only rough estimates." It also says orbit values are for epoch JD 2457400.5 (2016-01-13). The sheet does not mark each cell as estimate or measurement. A number on a later card from this sheet is the printed cell, under that warning. Author: Dr. David R. Williams. Last Updated line: 27 September 2019.
